m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Historical PR #676 M6/J case evidence and simulations concern two-swap +Ultimo/+Elektra over Crimson Cowl/Killmonger, not Cory's exact seven-swap October25 Loki 919734ad. The final 100 deliberately retains Cowl/Killmonger, instead cuts Thunderbolts Conspiracy, Kang Prime, Doctor Octopus, Venom Eddie Brock, Kang Temporal Tyrant, Dark Ritual, Path of Ancestry; adds Sakashima, Elektra, Ultimo, M.O.D.O.K. Evil Intellect, Living Lies, Kid Loki, City of Brass. Cases involving copied attack triggers, destroyed/removed Octopus anthem/refill, new clone and low Villain target costs were re-adjudicated on exact new 100. All 5 mandatory P0 and 8 P1 fixtures execute with explicit positive/adversarial branches, selected 2026-10-23 live Scryfall Oracle source and exact 100 SHA at engineering head b316ce6, CI #40178847336 successful. This is finite source-bound verification, not a reusable blanket M6 I/J certificate, an exhaustive rules engine, measured multiplayer win rate or global optimum.

P0.payable_fixture: Loki cast with 1 generic+U+B+R; Loki attacks with controlled Kid Loki Villain as legal target; response removes target.
P0.positive_assertion: Payable pips and battlefield target permit one tapped-attacking Illusion copy trigger, with delayed sacrifice.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Missing red pip, absent Kid target, or target removed before resolution permits no copy.

P0.payable_fixture: Loki triggers copy of Elektra/Ultimo; copy enters already attacking, not declared attacker.
P0.positive_assertion: Copied Elektra ETB targets eligible <=3 power creature; Ultimo ETB edicts each opponent; printed enters text activated by entry.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No copied attack trigger from entering-attacking status; no ETB result if copy never enters.

P0.payable_fixture: Villains deal combat damage to players A (2 Villains), B (1) and C (0).
P0.positive_assertion: Each Loki object draws once for A and B, twice total; 2 Loki objects separately draw four.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Two Villains hitting A are not two draws from one Loki; no damage draws zero.

P0.payable_fixture: Roaming Throne paid and set to Villain; controlled Loki attacks with Kid Loki target.
P0.positive_assertion: A trigger from another Villain creature Loki triggers an additional time; two legal token identities follow.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Wrong chosen creature type, Throne itself, or no controlled valid Villain target does not create additional copy.

P0.payable_fixture: Exact 100 excludes Oracle/Consult/Breach; 40 life opponent sees one 8-damage combat event.
P0.positive_assertion: Eight combat damage reduces 40 to 32; the deck must establish lethal combat or other demonstrated consequence.
P0.adversarial_assertion: No unconditional win from Loki card draw or a previously empty library before a failed draw; no blanket win-rate claim.

P1.payable_fixture: Loki created one Illusion token; current Master prevents token-sacrifice trigger, OR 1-mana untapped Sundial on your turn ends turn after trigger goes on stack.
P1.positive_assertion: Under either legally paid/satisfied retention condition, one named token persists beyond next end step.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without Master/valid Sundial window token goes; ending turn before delayed trigger merely postpones it; Master does not protect nontokens.

P1.payable_fixture: Scepter {2}{R} grants temporary Villain to controlled non-Villain Soldier until EOT, then Loki targets it.
P1.positive_assertion: Soldier is currently a valid Villain target, but its token copy preserves underlying Soldier plus Illusion and not continuous Villain effect.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without Scepter-granted Villain Soldier cannot be targeted; no illicit copying of layer-four temporary type grant.

P1.payable_fixture: Pay Loki 1UBR and Hall five generic separately, with Hall already controlled; Spark Double and Sakashima texts checked.
P1.positive_assertion: Nine specifically budgeted mana supports two separate payments; multiple legal Loki attackers may give independent copy triggers.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Eight mana cannot pay nine; Hall gaining creature status this turn lacks haste absent a source; no free second Loki.

P1.payable_fixture: One created Loki token and The Master/Sundial conditional preservation; Ultimo in exact list, Octopus removed.
P1.positive_assertion: One token persists only if an actual retention condition holds; copy Ultimo ETB remains available.
P1.adversarial_assertion: No Master/Sundial loses token at scheduled sacrifice; removed Octopus hand-refill cannot be counted.

P1.payable_fixture: Avengers saga gives two 2/1 Villains; retained Squadron Sinister +2/+2; combat blockers tracked.
P1.positive_assertion: Two unblocked 4/3 Villains can account for eight aggregate combat damage under actual Squadron static anthem.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without anthem damage four; blocked/prevented Villains do no player damage; removed Octopus anthem is not silently assumed.

P1.payable_fixture: Kindred Discovery cast with 3UU, Villain chosen, one Villain ETB and one attack; Rhystic Study tax optional.
P1.positive_assertion: Two qualifying Discovery events draw two and satisfy second-draw M.O.D.O.K. trigger.
P1.adversarial_assertion: One U pip cannot pay 3UU; Hero chosen, no trigger; Rhystic Study draw not guaranteed when opponent pays one.

P1.payable_fixture: Exact 100 retains Loki God of Mischief and adds Ultimo ETB; historical Kang Prime/Temporal removed.
P1.positive_assertion: Entering-attacking token creates ETB trigger for Ultimo, not the separately defined attack-event trigger.
P1.adversarial_assertion: No attack trigger may be counted from a token that was never declared attacker; removed Kangs have zero triggers.

P1.payable_fixture: Loki legally paid cast with Greaves/Boots optional haste and controlled Kid Loki target.
P1.positive_assertion: Loki present + able to attack + Villain target permits one attack-copy trigger.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Removed Loki, summoning-sick Loki without haste, or no legal target each yields zero copy triggers.
